title: Tone Room 1.4.0 embedded VTX preset bank
index_semantics: Zero-based position in the app embedded table. Correspondence to live factory-bank slot numbers and firmware contents requires readback verification.
value_semantics: parameters_raw are integers; apply the separate vtx-midi-reference.json for units, display scales and model-dependent definitions. raw_hex is the complete lossless record, including unknown bytes.
limitations: Static app contents, not a dump of the user amplifier.
The initializer copies this table at construction; live synchronization can replace app state.
Preset labels are exact stored names with trailing spaces removed; do not expand shortened labels into unsupported song/artist metadata.
